notes.title: Free Steam Market items drop every hour (without any limits)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28202086/a36c8cdef7d20d0133a23bcaf25ff24fc28268c1.png[/img]

Play Soccer Online: Ball 3D in any mode you want and after every 1 hour of playing you will get 1 key and 1 box (there are no limits, you can get as many keys as you can every day).

Then you can use these keys to open boxes and get free Steam Market items. You can sell these items on the Steam Market, trade with others or keep them for yourself and use in the game.

There are 5 types of items: common, uncommon, rare, very rare, legendary.

See the items you can get for free on the Steam Market: https://steamcommunity.com/market/search?appid=485610&snr=1_5_9_#p1_price_desc


What you will get from the box is visible (marked with a star icon) before you open it, so you know what you get before using the key. You can use every key to open any box you want. It is best to just preview all boxes and get the item that you want the most (from those currently marked with the star symbol).

Every new players will also get 5 free keys + 20 boxes (the items will drop a few minutes after you start the game for the first time).

New crafting system will be added to the game in the future that will let you craft even more rare items using your existing items, so it is worth collecting them.

Play Soccer Online: Ball 3D on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/485610/Soccer_Online_Ball_3D/

Have a nice game!

- Beginners can now use their rooms for 90 days but they can join to expert rooms after 14 days (same as it was before).

notes.title: Ball 3D is changing
notes.content:
Ball 3D is a very unique game, it is a new genre. An entire new gameplay that none other game offered before. It is a unique soccer experience, it gives players full control over the ball. It is a game that is constantly updated since 2012. The game deserves more popularity than it has. In times when developers change the games from paid to free to bring more players, I decided to do the opposite.

[b]Ball 3D will no longer be free from 26.06.2020.[/b]

[b]The players who already own the game, will keep it for free of course. [/b]But new players will have to pay the fair price for what the game offers.

Why such decision? Now the game is being downloaded by players who just download it because it's free. They play for 10 or less minutes and drop the game. Ball 3D is not a game that you can understand in less than 10 minutes. You need much more to appreciate the unique gameplay it offers.

Because the game offers only cosmetic items in the shop, the monetization is not good enough for me to invest money into advertisement to bring new players, into more dedicated servers for people all over the globe or to put some $ as the prizes for tournaments.

Paid game will also mean that people will respect their account more and they will behave better, because in case of ban, they will have to buy another copy of the game. It will also mean that we will have more mature community.

People who will buy the game on Steam, will not only get the game, but also a 1 year of PRO account and 2 nick changes for free.

Along with the free to paid switch, I will create an update to improve the experience for all players.

This is how I intended this game to work from the beginning, but for various reasons I was forced to decrease the speed just before realising the game 8 years ago. Now you will experience the real Ball 3D as I imagined it.

This new mode is available on the FAST rooms, test it and let me know what you think, I will improve these new rooms in the upcoming weeks.

The old slow rooms are still available as the main mode of the game for old players and they will stay in the game, so don't worry about this.
